visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors on a sunlit wooden deck, a man in a grey kimono guides a toddler in a red toy car down a plastic slide against a backdrop of dense green trees. (2) Inside a modern subway station, the man in black casual wear walks hand-in-hand with the toddler past a large purple dragon mural. (3) A multi-story hotel building with green signage and balconies is shown under a clear blue sky. (4) Indoors, a sequence of amenities: a drink dispenser, organized shelves of manga books, and a playroom where the father helps the child onto a toy rocking horse. (5) High-angle shot of the child playing in a vibrant green and yellow ball pit. (6) Close-ups of shelves stocked with baby supplies and drawers filled with various baby food pouches labeled for different ages. (7) A spacious dining area features multiple wooden tables and wall-mounted TVs playing cartoons. Close-ups show appetizing plates of noodles, skewers, sliced beef, and grilled scallops. (8) A staff member in a floral shirt interacts with the child at a dining table. A celebratory cake with a lit sparkler is presented. (9) A private hot spring room (onsen) is shown with wooden walls and a dinosaur graphic on the glass door, followed by a bathroom sink with dinosaur-shaped soap dispensers. (10) The family of three waves at the camera in front of a blue hotel banner. (11) A final close-up features the mother holding the child while speaking directly to the camera.
